title: Hershel ‘Woody' Williams National Medal of Honor Monument Location Act
official_summary:
Hershel "Woody" Williams National Medal of Honor Monument Location Act

This bill requires the authorized monument honoring Medal of Honor recipients to be located within the Reserve (the great cross-axis of the National Mall, which generally extends from the Capitol to the Lincoln Memorial and from the White House to the Jefferson Memorial).

summary.headline: Requires the planned national monument honoring Medal of Honor recipients to be built within the central area of the National Mall.
summary.what_it_does: This law requires the already-authorized monument honoring Medal of Honor recipients to be placed within the Reserve, the central cross-shaped area of the National Mall that runs from the Capitol to the Lincoln Memorial and from the White House to the Jefferson Memorial.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Upon enactment on September 10, 2026; the summary gives no other dates.
